---
title: "Rational Choice Theory and the Papal Conclave"
date: "2005-04-05"
categories: ["Economics"]
---

Can rational choice theory be used to divine the Will of God?  [You bet](http://www.wcfia.harvard.edu/seminars/pegroup/toman.pdf "You bet").

[Intrade](http://www.intrade.com/apply.jsp?heardFromPromotionDetail=s0545138709r "Intrade") is running both successor and country of origin markets for the next Pope.  The latter market suggests that the Italians have it.
